filter_airlines: SELECT DISTINCT airline_name FROM marts.flights_performance WHERE airline_name IS NOT NULL ORDER BY airline_name
filter_airports: SELECT DISTINCT airport_code FROM marts.flights_performance WHERE airport_code IS NOT NULL ORDER BY airport_code
top_routes:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN movement_type = 'D' THEN airport_code ELSE origin_destination_code END AS origin_airport_code,
    CASE WHEN movement_type = 'D' THEN origin_destination_code ELSE airport_code END AS destination_airport_code,
    airline_name,
    COUNT(*) AS total_flights,
    COUNTIF(is_cancelled) AS cancelled_flights,
    COUNTIF(NOT is_cancelled AND delay_minutes <= 0) AS on_time_flights,
    AVG(CASE WHEN delay_minutes BETWEEN -180 AND 600 THEN delay_minutes END) AS raw_avg_delay,
    COUNTIF(delay_minutes BETWEEN -180 AND 600) AS completed_flights
  FROM marts.flights_performance
  WHERE {{ filter_date_range('flight_date', 'date_range') }}
    AND {{ filter('airline_name', 'airline') }}
    AND {{ filter('airport_code', 'airport') }}
    AND {{ filter('flight_direction', 'direction') }}
    AND {{ filter('time_of_day', 'time_of_day') }}
    AND {{ filter('delay_category', 'delay_category') }}
  GROUP BY origin_airport_code, destination_airport_code, airline_name
)
SELECT
  origin_airport_code,
  destination_airport_code,
  airline_name,
  total_flights,
  cancelled_flights,
  ROUND(raw_avg_delay, 1) AS avg_delay_minutes,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(on_time_flights, total_flights) * 100, 1) AS on_time_pct,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(cancelled_flights, total_flights) * 100, 1) AS cancellation_pct
FROM base
WHERE completed_flights >= 5
ORDER BY total_flights DESC
LIMIT 15
gate_perf:
SELECT
  gate,
  COUNT(*) AS total_flights,
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN delay_minutes BETWEEN -180 AND 600 THEN delay_minutes END), 1) AS avg_delay_minutes,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNTIF(NOT is_cancelled AND delay_minutes <= 0), COUNT(*)) * 100, 1) AS on_time_pct,
  MAX(delay_minutes) AS max_delay_minutes
FROM marts.flights_performance
WHERE {{ filter_date_range('flight_date', 'date_range') }}
  AND {{ filter('airline_name', 'airline') }}
  AND {{ filter('airport_code', 'airport') }}
  AND {{ filter('flight_direction', 'direction') }}
  AND gate IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(gate) != ''
GROUP BY gate
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 20
ORDER BY total_flights DESC
LIMIT 15
